# Model providers

The providers Indus Agent knows without any setup. `indus model` picks one.

## Catalogue

| Name | Provider | Aliases | Key variables | Endpoint variable | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `openrouter` | OpenRouter | `or` | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` |  | `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` |
| `openai` | OpenAI | `openai-api` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.openai.com/v1` |
| `openai-codex` | OpenAI (ChatGPT sign-in) | `chatgpt` |  |  | `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex` |
| `anthropic` | Anthropic | `claude` | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.anthropic.com` |
| `gemini` | Google Gemini | `google` | `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY` |  | `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` |
| `deepseek` | DeepSeek |  | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.deepseek.com/v1` |
| `xai` | xAI | `grok` | `XAI_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.x.ai/v1` |
| `mistral` | Mistral AI |  | `MISTRAL_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.mistral.ai/v1` |
| `huggingface` | Hugging Face | `hf` | `HF_TOKEN` |  | `https://router.huggingface.co/v1` |
| `nvidia` | NVIDIA NIM | `nim` | `NVIDIA_API_KEY` |  | `https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1` |
| `zai` | Z.ai | `glm` | `ZAI_API_KEY`, `GLM_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4` |
| `kimi-coding` | Kimi (Moonshot AI) | `kimi`, `moonshot` | `MOONSHOT_API_KEY`, `KIMI_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.moonshot.ai/v1` |
| `minimax` | MiniMax |  | `MINIMAX_API_KEY` |  | `https://api.minimax.io/anthropic` |
| `alibaba` | Alibaba Cloud Model Studio | `dashscope`, `qwen` | `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` |  | `https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` |
| `ai-gateway` | Vercel AI Gateway | `vercel` | `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` |  | `https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1` |
| `ollama-cloud` | Ollama Cloud |  | `OLLAMA_API_KEY` |  | `https://ollama.com/v1` |
| `lmstudio` | LM Studio | `lm-studio` | `LM_API_KEY` | `LM_BASE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1` |
| `custom` | Custom endpoint |  | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `OPENAI_BASE_URL` |  |

## Local servers

Model servers on this machine at their usual ports; no key needed.

| Name | Provider | Aliases | Key variables | Endpoint variable | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ollama` | Ollama (local) |  |  |  | `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` |
| `vllm` | vLLM (local) |  |  |  | `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1` |
| `llamacpp` | llama.cpp (local) | `llama.cpp`, `llama-cpp` |  |  | `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1` |

Any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint is added under `providers:` in `config.yaml` (see [Configuration keys](configuration.md)).
